name: Tile Binning for Splatting
definition: Groups depth-sorted splats into tile buckets (16x16 pixel blocks) using a count-then-scatter two-pass approach to improve cache locality during compositing.
summary: Tile Binning for Splatting groups depth-sorted splats into per-tile buckets via a count-then-scatter approach to improve cache locality, differing from stable radix-sort by explicitly computing tile boundaries.
